messages.content: Come up with a name for a brand that consists of one or at most two words, for the manufacture of neon-lit advertising signs that is easy to pronounce and does not already exist on the Internet. 20 names. The output should not contain any whitespace.

message.reasoning:

- One or at most two words
- Easy to pronounce
- Does not already exist on the Internet (I'll aim for unique combinations/invented words)
- Output should NOT contain any whitespace (no spaces, no newlines between entries... wait, but I need 20 names. Let me re-read: "The output should not contain any whitespace." This means no spaces, no newlines, no tabs. I'll separate them with commas or just list them without any whitespace characters at all.)
